description: FAYNOVA is a passionate and ambitious team driven by curiosity and a shared love for science, space, and technology. Our team consists of two members, Avina Tabarestani and Aynour Eghtedayi, who combine their ideas, skills, and determination to explore innovative solutions to real-world challenges. Through NASA Space Apps Challenge, we aim to turn our curiosity into meaningful discoveries and push the boundaries of what we can achieve. We believe every great discovery begins with an idea!
